question: On what authority is the seat-place said to exist both externally and within the body?
premises: The seat-place has both external and internal forms.
It is present outside and in the body.
The Supreme Lord set this forth clearly in the revered Naiśa transmission.
inference: The twofold seat-place, outer and bodily, is established by explicit scriptural teaching from the Supreme Lord.
uncertainties: The exact title or scope of śrīnaiśasañcāra is not explained within this verse.
plain_english: That seat-place exists in both external and internal form, outside and in the body, because the Supreme Lord clearly set this forth in the revered Naiśa transmission.
